parse.title: Love Island USA (Season 8)
parse.wikitext:
==Weekly Summary==
<tabber>
|-|Coupling=
{| class="wikitable" style="width: 96%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 1
|
*On Day 1, the islanders coupled up for the first time with the girls standing behind the door of the boy they would like to couple up with. Trinity coupled up with Bryce, Beatriz chose Sean, and Kenzie picked Zach. As Aniya and Melanie both chose Sincere, he was given the power, to which he chose to pair up with Melanie. As no-one stood behind KC's door, he was automatically coupled up with Aniya.
*On Day 3, new islanders Gabriel and Kayda were given the chance to couple up. However, they were only allowed to choose islanders who offered to be their partner. Beatriz and Trinity both offered to couple up with Gabriel, while Bryce and Zach both offered to couple up with Kayda. Ultimately, Gabriel chose to couple up with Beatriz, and Kayda picked Zach. As a result, Trinity and Bryce remained in their couple, while Kenzie and Sean were left single.
*On Day 6, the islanders re-coupled for the first time with the girls choosing who they wanted to couple up with. However, as the newest arrival, Corbin was given first pick, to which he chose Kenzie. Aniya and KC, Beatriz and Gabriel, Kayda and Zach, Melanie and Sincere, and Trinity and Bryce all remained in their couples. As Sean remained single, he was dumped from the island.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 2
|
*On Day 10, it was revealed that America had been voting for islanders the bombshells would couple up with. Caleb was coupled with Kenzie, Jen with Gabriel, and Sol with Sincere. As a result, Beatriz, Corbin and Melanie were left single and vulnerable. Corbin was then given the power to save one girl to be in a couple with him. As he chose Melanie, Beatriz was dumped from the island.
*On Day 13, the islanders recoupled by writing love letters to who they wanted to couple up with. As Aniya and KC, Jen and Gabriel, Kayda and Zach, and Trinity and Bryce mutually wrote letters to one another, they remained in their couples. Caleb and Corbin both wrote letters to Kenzie, while she only wrote one for Corbin, and as a result they coupled up. Similarly, Melanie and Sol both wrote letters for Sincere, while he only wrote one for Melanie, therefore they coupled up. As Caleb and Sol did not receive a letter, they were automatically coupled up.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 3
|
*On Day 20, the original islanders were told that they would be re-coupling. They were given the option to remain in their current couple, or to choose one of the new islanders. However, as the boys and the girls were living in separate villas, they were not aware of what the other one chose. Kayda and Zach, Melanie and Sincere, and Trinity and Bryce all chose to remain in their couples. Elsewhere, Caleb chose to couple up with Jaiden, Corbin picked Parmida, Kenzie went with Dylan, and Jen chose Gal. As Aniya decided to remain loyal to KC, but he chose to twist and couple up with Tierra, she remained in the villa as a single islander. The remaining single Casa islanders were dumped from the island after failing to be in a couple.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 4
|
*On Day 25, the islanders recoupled with the boys choosing which girl they wanted to couple up with. Kayda and Zach, Kenzie and Dylan, Melanie and Sincere, Parmida and Caleb, Tierra and KC, and Trinity and Bryce remained in their couples. Elsewhere, Carl picked Aniya, and Gal chose Amora. As Jen failed to couple up, she was dumped from the island.
|}

|-|Challenges=
{| class="wikitable" style="width: 96%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 1
|
*On Day 1, the islanders took part in a game in which Ariana asked them questions where they would stand in front of a door to lock in an answer. If an islander of the opposite gender was on the other side of the door, they would get to kiss one another.
*On Day 4, the islanders took part in a game in which they had to answer a series of facts relating to their fellow islanders. To lock in their answer, they had to push the islander they thought the question related to into the pool.
*On Day 5, the islanders took part in a office style challenge where the female islanders were tasked with selecting a boy not in their couple to kiss, and then answer a question. The islander they chose would be thrown into a slime pit. The female islanders would then go into a secret room and kiss the new boy, Corbin.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 2
|
*On Day 10, the girls and boys went head-to-head in the "Sweet as Pie" challenge, where they had to answer a series of questions about the opposing team. During a "nice" round, they locked their answer by giving the islander a kiss. Meanwhile, during a "naughty" round, they locked their answer by giving the islander a pie to the face.
*On Day 11, the couples competed in a soccer style team challenge. It involved moving a soccer ball without their hands, eating a hot dog controlled by their legs, collecting slime from an inflatable pool, and dumping it on an islander who the couple thought fit the description of the "Red Card" question.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 4
|
*On Day 21, [[Wikipedia:Megan Thee Stallion|Megan Thee Stallion]] hosted a girls vs boys challenge. In the first round, music would play and the islanders had to sit on a cake once it stopped. In the second round, each team got to throw a cake at the opposing team members. In the final round, each team had a representative eat a cake to find a heart in the middle. The girls won the first two rounds, while the boys won the final round.
*On Day 26, the couples took part in a karaoke challenge. As Kenzie and Dylan were declared the winners, they were granted safety from the public vote.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 5
|
*On Day 30, the couples competed in the "Check Me Out" challenge. The couples had to transfer grocery ingredients to a scale using only their mouths, before going down a slip-and-slide, and finishing with a kiss.
|}

|-|Dates=
{| class="wikitable" style="width: 96%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 1
|
*On Day 3, new islanders Kayda and Gabriel were given the chance to take two islanders of their choice on a date. Kayda chose Bryce and Zach, while Gabriel picked Beatriz and Trinity.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 2
|
*On Day 11, Kayda and Zach spent the night in the hideaway.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 4
|
*On Day 22, Trinity and Bryce left the villa to go on their first date.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 5
|
*On Day 27, Melanie and Sincere spent the night in the hideaway.
*On Day 31, the four remaining couples went on their final dates.
|}

|-|Exits=
{| class="wikitable" style="width: 96%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 1
|
*On Day 6, Sean was dumped from the island after failing to couple up.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 2
|
*On Day 10, Beatriz was dumped from the island after not being chosen by Corbin.
*On Day 14, it was revealed that America had been voting for their favourite couple. As Caleb and Sol, Corbin and Kenzie, and Jen and Gabriel received the fewest votes, they became vulnerable. It was then up to the safe girls to decide which boy would be dumped from the island, and the safe boys to determine which girl. The girls chose to dump Gabriel, and the boys picked Sol.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 3
|
*On Day 17, the original girls had to choose which 6 of the 12 Casa Amor boys would remain in the villa. They ultimately chose to dump Chandlar, Keyon, Kyle, Ryan, Tino and Trae.
*On Day 19, Alannah was removed from the villa due to evidence surfacing of her using a racial slur.
*On Day 20, Casa Amor islanders Amora, Carl, Chay, Corey, Ronnie, and Sydney were dumped from the island after failing to couple up.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 4
|
*On Day 25, Jen was dumped from the island after failing to couple up.
*On Day 25, the couples were each asked to vote for which two couples they deemed to be the least compatible. Parmida and Corbin received 1 vote, Melanie and Sincere received 2, Kenzie and Dylan received 3, Jaiden and Caleb received 4, and Amora and Gal received 8. As Amora and Gal, and Jaiden and Caleb received the most votes, they were dumped from the island.
*On Day 26, it was revealed that the public had been voting for their favorite couple. As Kenzie and Dylan, Kayda and Zach, and Parmida and Corbin received the fewest votes, they were at risk of being dumped from the island. However, as Kenzie and Dylan won the karaoke challenge, they were granted safety. It was then up to the safe couples to decide which couple they wanted to save. As Parmida and Corbin only received one vote, while Kayda and Zach received 4 votes, Parmida and Corbin were dumped from the island.
|-
! style="width: 6%;" | Week 5
|
*On Day 30, it was revealed that the public had been voting for the four couples they wanted to see in the final. As Kenzie and Dylan, and KC and Tierra received the fewest votes, they were dumped from the island.
|}
</tabber>
